title: Research: exhibit thirteen disjoint P112 binary frames
body:
## Summary

Exhibit thirteen disjoint orthonormal 8-frames on the literal P112 binary labels, answering PR3335 open question 1. Its previous best was twelve; thirteen is now constructive and fourteen remains open.

```diff
-best exhibited packing: 12 frames
+checked packing: 13 frames on 104 distinct ports
+packing number: 13 <= nu <= 14
```

The new matching has an explicit rank-34 scalar fit and a verified 32-to-34 minimum-rank bracket over every field. No smaller fitting-rank upper bound, native COPY invoice or new kappa is claimed. The proof, exact certificate, two separate checkers, optional bounded discovery, source pins and open next questions are in `research/paired-plane-frame-packing/`.

## Evidence

- Before: PR3335 `1d46df8b5aeac49d165cae58c1dd1036666bb789` reported twelve frames and asked whether twelve was maximal.
- After: all thirteen Gram-I8 blocks and the 112-port partition pass exact checks. Both implementations check all 11,360 forced scalar entries. The independent dense implementation obtains rank 34 modulo 2, 3 and 1,000,003. Six primary rejection controls and a dense same-plane-zero mutation pass.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay passes: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/paired-plane-frame-packing`.
- Committed-byte/source-history preflight, Git-free committed-export replay, optimized direct replay, Ruff and diff checks pass. The full selected supplier replay and native implementation are outside scope.

Credit PR3335/Matarener/Mark for the question and previous packing, with the retained PR2471/2484/1825/1889/2118 and plane-port lineage detailed in the README. Canonical base is `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`, priority revision 6. Final overlap refresh found the separate literal-support tariff and block-rank audits, whose scope is preserved.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

Nine new files in one package. No selected record, supplier, shared checker or frozen source is changed.
